permissionPolicy.title: Job title permissions
permissionPolicy.description: Choose which Job Titles may hold each permission in this company. A restriction removes the permission from every other Job Title at once; the platform default leaves everything as it is today. The company manager can then grant or deny a permission per person, only inside what you allow here.

permissionPolicy.defaultClosed: Platform default: every Job Title keeps what it has. It cannot be granted to a person whose Job Title does not already hold it until you restrict it and select that Job Title.
